main.content:
== Wiki Organization Guidelines ==

These guidelines outline the improved organizational structure for BITwiki using Semantic MediaWiki and transclusion principles.

=== Portals ===
* Ideas Portal - Theoretical concepts and knowledge areas
* Implementations Portal - Actual projects and working systems
* Domains Portal - Knowledge domains like Biology, Electronics, etc.
* Site Portal - Site governance and community information

=== Semantic Organization ===
* Use semantic properties to create explicit relationships between pages
* Replace traditional categories with semantic classifications
* Create dynamic navigation through semantic queries
* Implement faceted classification systems

=== Transclusion Structure ===
* Enable modular content structure through transclusion
* Separate content from presentation
* Create reusable components
* Use namespaces to organize different types of content

=== Knowledge Graph ===
* Build explicit semantic relationships between pages
* Visualize knowledge graphs using available tools
* Create interconnected knowledge bases
* Track content evolution and relationships

=== Implementation ===
* Start with defining semantic properties for different page types
* Set up transclusion systems for modular content
* Configure visualization tools for knowledge graphs
* Create templates for consistent page structures
